name: mp-reconnect-relay
title: A player's game is stopped on its own machine and started again there; it rejoins its running round over the relay

scripts.dropped.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Joiner
activate ButtonMultiplayerJoinGame
wait_ms 600
assert_substate JoinSetup
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 120
wait_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 120
click_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json
assert_label LabelJoinSelected internet
assert_enabled ButtonMultiplayerConnect 1
activate ButtonMultiplayerConnect
wait_connected 1 120
wait_substate Lobby 120
wait_ms 1200
activate ButtonMultiplayerReady
wait_round_end 900
exit
scripts.rejoined.menu:
wait_ms 1800
assert_substate Landing
assert_label ButtonMultiplayerReconnect Rejoin Match
activate ButtonMultiplayerReconnect
wait_round_end 900
exit

checklist.what: The player plays its seat of the round over the relay before its game is stopped.
The round plays on while the player's game is stopped on its box.
checklist.assert: the dropped player's runner record carries injected_termination

checklist.what: The stopped game's recording is collected up to its stop.
checklist.assert: frames.jsonl is flushed per frame; the manifest is absent on a killed peer, which is expected

checklist.what: Started again on its own box from the stopped game's files, the player presses Rejoin Match and plays its own seat again.
Every connection this player makes to its host goes through the relay.
Every connection this player makes to its host goes through the relay.
